mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 73 degrees with overcast skies at Firemans Park and a first quarter moon phase.

The city is currently recruiting an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects, and residents are reminded that sewer and stormwater utility rates were recently adjusted to ensure our systems remain self-supporting.
Enjoy live music today at Baileys Run, visit the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow at the Capitol, or check out the Verona Downtown Farmers Market on August 26.
In a notable report from August 15, Verona police officers conducted a traffic stop and arrested a driver for an O W I after she was found unresponsive behind the wheel.
Cool off today with the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day at Culver's, which is open until 10:30 PM.
